---
title: "About"
---

Two weekly series on computational heterogeneous catalysis:

- **AI & ML in Catalysis** — autonomous catalysis: orchestration agents, foundation-model
  machine-learning interatomic potentials, self-driving labs, and the reliability of all three.
- **ML for Chemical Kinetics** — machine learning for reaction-network discovery, microkinetic
  modelling, kinetic Monte Carlo, rate-constant prediction, and reactor-scale coupling.

Each post connects three recent papers — a "triangle" — and states what becomes visible only when
the three are read together.

Curated by Juan Manuel Arce-Ramos
([ORCID 0000-0002-6561-544X](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6561-544X)),
Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), Singapore.

**How the posts are made.** An AI assistant does the weekly literature scan, builds the triangle,
drafts the post, and runs an independent fact-check of every claim against the full text of the
cited papers. Juan directs the topics, edits the framing, and approves every post before it is
published. Each post states this at the end. Corrections are welcome.
